headline: Gland Pharma Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Gland Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 100% of the equity share capital of Gland Pharma USA Inc. , a wholly-owned step down subsidiary of the Company, from Gland Pharma International Pte.
